text.en:
Civil List and Pension Act
(CHAPTER 44)
It is hereby notified for general information that the following resolution was passed at a meeting of Parliament on 17th February 2012.
“That this Parliament, pursuant to section 7 of the Civil List and Pension Act (Chapter 44), resolves that the Schedule to that Act be varied by deleting the figures “$4,267,500”, “$2,068,300”, and “$659,300” in the second column and substituting the figures “$1,568,900”, “$2,762,300” and “$550,000”, respectively.”.
